runtime: Codex embedded Chromium; production Vite preview for upgraded scene
method: Point samples from two-second mean frame intervals after warmup. Complete-frame renderer.info includes shadow and postprocessing draws. Only one active town renderer during recorded samples.

baseline.note: Isolated baseline Vite dev copy; only a diagnostic counter was added. Baseline fixed DPR differs from upgraded adaptive DPR. These are not matched-quality benchmarks.

upgradedDesktopFinal.note: Final production build. Baseline fixed DPR 1.25 differs from upgraded adaptive DPR 1; the FPS comparison is not matched quality. Desktop and mobile measurements use different viewports and CPU throttle settings.
